issues.title: Same filename in multiple sessions
issues.description: "channels_001.tsv" appears in 2 different sessions for subject "001" (ses-postimplant, ses-preimplant). This might be the same file accidentally assigned to multiple sessions. Verify each copy is actually from a different session.

issues.title: 1 channel with no matching electrode
issues.description: Patient_001/Session_implant/ieeg/channels_001.tsv lists 1 electrode channel that is not in Patient_001/Session_implant/ieeg/electrodes_001.tsv: LA3. Tools match channels to electrode positions by exact name, so these recordings would have no location. Fix the names in the source tables so they agree.
